the use of the altitudinal gradient of climate variables in mountainous catchment modelling can improve the simulation of river discharges, even when the available climate stations are not representative of the whole catchment; and, the use of the gradient of climate variables alone can be more efficient than the use of the available climate data plus synthetic data at a higher altitude, even when the latter are better distributed in the catchment.
